copy.metaDescription: See which UK seed-stage payments companies have raised the most, from Adfin at £24.2m to Paytia at £2.2m, with location and team size breakdowns.
intro: This page ranks 24 UK seed-stage payments companies by total raised. Adfin leads the list with £24.2m, followed by TuningBill with £19.1m.
The combined total raised across all 24 companies is £172.4m. The table and statistics show how funding is spread across the group.

sections.heading: How the Funding Is Spread Across the Group
paragraphs: The median total raised is £5.4m, while the mean is £7.2m. The mean sits higher because a small number of companies raised considerably more than the rest.
14 of the 24 companies have at least £5m raised, and 5 of the 24 have at least £10m. The top 6 companies hold 53.2% of the combined total, which is £91.8m.

sections.heading: Where the UK Seed-Stage Payments Companies Are Based
paragraphs: London is home to the majority of companies in this group, with 21 of the 24 based there. Those London companies account for £159.3m of the combined total.
The North East, South East and Wales each have one company in the group. Their combined totals are £2.7m, £6.6m and £3.8m respectively.

sections.heading: Team Size Across the Ranked Companies
paragraphs: The largest group by team size is companies with 10 to 24 employees, with 12 companies in total. This group has a combined total raised of £65.5m.

Companies with 25 to 49 employees form a group of 5, with a combined total of £59.6m. Smaller teams of under 5 employees number 3 and have a combined total of £27m, while teams of 5 to 9 employees number 2 with £8.3m combined.

sections.heading: Leading Companies in the Ranking
paragraphs: Adfin develops an online platform which aims to reduce the administrative burden of invoicing and payments for businesses. TuningBill develops a cross-border invoice discounting tool for investors, buyers and sellers.

nsave operates global banking accounts for transferring money and investing, and Outpost develops an automated Merchant of Record and Tax of Record platform. Lopay develops a payment processor and software for retail vendors.
